description: This Java source file defines the UiWatchers class, which registers UI watchers for handling Android app not responding (ANR) and crash dialogs during UI testing. It includes methods for registering watchers, handling detected errors, and interacting with UI elements.

classes.name: UiWatchers
classes.description: A class that registers UI watchers to detect and handle ANR and crash dialogs during Android UI tests.

methods.name: registerAnrAndCrashWatchers
methods.description: Registers watchers for ANR and crash dialogs, which detect specific UI elements indicating errors and handle them.

methods.name: postHandler
methods.description: Handles UI interactions after detecting an error, such as clicking OK buttons.
